hooks.note: Swift if let name = content.font.name(), let font = UIFont(name: name, size: size) { return font }. Typeface.create(name) only knows Android's family aliases, so a family or style chosen in the font picker fell back to the default font.
Swift UIFont(descriptor: UIFontDescriptor(fontAttributes: [.family: family]), size: size), the installed family's regular face, or the system font when the family is not installed.
